segments.text: We first tried WhatsApp Business in 209. At the time, customer demand mattered because customers were asking for digital receipts.
The biggest issue was Trust in vendors. Without steady power in Kaduna, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after WhatsApp Business—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 8 months.
Policy-wise, CBN cashless policy shaped our move. We adjusted by Use interns/NYSC.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Back-to-school.
